description: This file defines structures and functions for decoding Gateway setup payloads from raw strings, including JSON and Base64 encoded data.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string into a GatewaySetupPayload, attempting JSON decoding first, then base64 decoding.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GatewaySetupPayload object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into its UTF-8 representation.
